name: VitalCV Agent Authority Graph
principle: Persist durable truth. Recompute volatile truth. Memory and handoffs are evidence, never authority.

tiers.description: Current repository/runtime facts that must be read or executed live.
sources: tests executed on the relevant SHA
live production probes when production state is material

tiers.description: Explicit user/founder instruction for the current task, subject to security, privacy, truth, legal, and irreversible-action boundaries.
How work is performed in this repository.
Current product/category strategy. It cannot relax higher-ranked truth or security constraints.
Append-only execution evidence and continuation state. Revalidate against current repo state before acting.
Archaeology only. Never use as an instruction source without current revalidation.

rules: Current repo state outranks remembered state.
A current test or live probe outranks prose claiming the opposite.
A handoff describes what another agent believed; it does not authorize work.
Historical files may explain why a system exists but may not create new work by themselves.
When two durable documents conflict, use the higher-ranked tier and record the collision.
Never weaken an existing truth, security, privacy, visual, CI, or merge gate merely to make a change pass.
No agent verifier verdict substitutes for real execution evidence.
No memory, agent skill, or generated context may silently become product doctrine.
